test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT one of the objectives of Liberalisation?

options.text: To develop a global market of a country
To promote foreign trade and regulate imports and exports
To boost competition between domestic businesses
To mitigate effects of the technology and foreign capital

solution:
The correct answer is __**To mitigate the effects of the technology and foreign capital**__.
